decisions.reason: The hearty bread runs on existing lines at little cost, and with no recent evidence against it there is no reason to drop it, so the option stays open.

The mill tour uses heritage and event facilities the firm already has at low marginal cost, and demand should be recovering after the pandemic, so keeping it preserves upside for the hospitality business.
The farmhouse bread is close to the core assortment and cheap to keep, and the lack of website archives says nothing about its performance, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship seasonal product whose value has largely been shown, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The gold-awarded premium stollen fits the firm's festive gift business at low incremental cost, and its demonstrated quality supports keeping it.
